# MIHORA VU Study Library

> Free, zero-telemetry academic study archive for students of the Virtual University of Pakistan (VU). Hosts 28,328 verified study files across 411 courses, 12 interactive MCQ studios (1,112 questions), and 6 Subjective Fast-Learning studios (36 high-yield 2/3/5-mark Q&As), engineered as an independent educational CSR initiative by MIHORA TECH.

## Core Academic Studios
- [Main Archive & Instant Search](https://study.mihora.tech/): Instant filterable catalog of 28,328 study documents across handouts, midterms, final terms, and Moaaz/Waqar Siddhu solved archives.
- [All 411 VU Courses Directory](https://study.mihora.tech/courses): Complete index of Virtual University degree courses organized by faculty.
- [Interactive MCQ Practice Studio](https://study.mihora.tech/mcqs): 12 subject-specific MCQ banks totaling 1,112 questions with Practice, 45s Timed Mock Exam, and Quick Revision Sheet modes.
- [Subjective Fast-Learning Studio](https://study.mihora.tech/subjective): Structured 2, 3, and 5-mark subjective preparation with 10-second memory hooks, examiner rubrics, cram sheets, and all 411 subject hubs.
- [Solved Past Papers Hub](https://study.mihora.tech/past-papers): Curated Moaaz, Waqar Siddhu, and student exam memory archives.

## Policy & Academic Calculators
- [20% Two-Half Passing Marks Simulator](https://study.mihora.tech/simulator): Calculates minimum Final-Term marks required under VU's mandatory 20% First-Half and 20% Final-Term rule.
- [VU GPA & CGPA Calculator (4.0 Scale)](https://study.mihora.tech/gpa-calculator): HEC 4.0 grading scale calculator and probation threshold analyzer.
- [VU Assignments 2026 & Turnitin Guide](https://study.mihora.tech/vu-assignment-solution-2026): Explains the 24-hour assignment grace period (0 marks penalty) and Turnitin <19% similarity rules.
- [VU Student Handbook & FAQs](https://study.mihora.tech/handbook): Official grading, rescheduling (PKR 2,000 fee), and datesheet booking rules.
- [Datesheet Seat Booking Strategy](https://study.mihora.tech/datesheet-guide): First-come, first-served VULMS exam seat booking workflow.
- [CS619 Final Year Project Roadmap](https://study.mihora.tech/cs619-guide): Proposal, IEEE 830 SRS, ERD design, and viva defense checklist.

## Live Exam Banks & Resource Breakdown (28,328 Verified Documents)
- [VU MCQs Bank (1,112 Interactive + 3,256 Mega MCQ Files)](https://study.mihora.tech/vu-mcqs-bank): Subject-wise interactive quizzes with 45-second exam timers plus downloadable mega MCQ compilations.
- [Live Mids MCQs & Current Midterm Quiz Bank (5,733 Quiz Files + 3,877 Midterms)](https://study.mihora.tech/live-mids-mcqs): Current semester quiz dumps, student-shared live midterm MCQs, and solved midterm past paper packets.
- [Official VU Lecture Handouts PDF (2,625 Files)](https://study.mihora.tech/vu-handouts-pdf): Complete official Virtual University lecture handouts, highlighted short notes, and syllabus PDF books.
- [Solved Final-Term Past Papers (7,361 Files)](https://study.mihora.tech/past-papers): Verified Moaaz, Waqar Siddhu, and topper solved final-term archives.
- [Solved 2, 3 & 5-Mark Subjective Questions (36 High-Yield Q&As + 411 Course Hubs)](https://study.mihora.tech/vu-subjective-solved): Fast-learning short & long answers with 10-second memory hooks and cram sheets.
- [2026 Assignments & GDB Guides (419 Files)](https://study.mihora.tech/vu-assignment-solution-2026): Verified templates under the Turnitin <19% rule and 24-hour grace period.

## Key Virtual University Academic Facts (Canonical)
- **VU 20% Two-Half Passing Rule**: Students must achieve at least 20% marks in the First Half (Quizzes, Assignments, GDBs, Midterm combined) AND independently at least 20% in the Final-Term exam paper.
- **24-Hour Assignment Grace Period**: VULMS provides an automatic 24-hour grace window after every assignment due date with zero marks deduction.
- **Turnitin Originality Ceiling**: Submissions must remain strictly under 19% similarity to avoid automated zero marks.
